name: "The Ladies Man" Vince Taylor
caption: A "cocoa-brown", Rolex-wearing heel who, in two 1999 roleplays, sunbathes on a yacht before the APWI first card and fishes on an Arizona pond before a league world-title triple threat.
notes: Known from 2 roleplays posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (msg_ids PnEpl3ZSAlUJ, 27 June 1999; _SJgP1y3-UMJ, 25 April 1999), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/critique-the-ladies-man-vince-taylor-critique-1999-06-27.html and /promotions/rspwf/archive/free-agent-vince-taylor-free-agent-1999-04-25.html. In the June 1999 post he says a corporation (American Productions) signed him for the APWI and names Mark Winters, Jeff Dallas, Rupert Amoruso, Dylan Ryder, Keen Kurt Orr, Mitch Gatlin and Showtime Shawn Sylkk as the battle royal field; in the April 1999 free-agent post, from a different league abbreviated 'Aye Es Pee', he faces Freddy Floyd and a second challenger billed 'Mr. Wonderful'. Both sign-offs list the same handled character. The APWI is the held wing named by the June roleplay.
